title: Understanding Blazor Component State
description:
Blazor components can respond to user interactions by updating component
state and rendering the UI again. A variable such as a Boolean can
control whether a section is visible, while event handlers connect
buttons and form submissions to C# methods. Data binding keeps input
values synchronized with component properties, and EditForm can use
validation attributes to check values before calling a submit handler.

@page "/component-state-demo"

<PageTitle>Component State Demo</PageTitle>

<div class="container py-5">
    <div class="card shadow-sm mx-auto" style="max-width: 500px;">
        <div class="card-body text-center">
            <h3 class="fw-bold mb-3">
                Understanding Component State
            </h3>

            <p class="text-secondary">
                The current counter value is stored in component state.
            </p>

            <div class="display-3 fw-bold text-primary mb-4">
                @count
            </div>

            <button class="btn btn-primary me-2"
                    @onclick="IncrementCount">
                <i class="bi bi-plus-circle me-1"></i>
                Increase
            </button>

            <button class="btn btn-outline-danger"
                    @onclick="ResetCount">
                <i class="bi bi-arrow-counterclockwise me-1"></i>
                Reset
            </button>

            <hr />

            <p class="mb-0">
                @message
            </p>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

@code {
    private int count = 0;

    private string message = "Click Increase to update the state.";

    private void IncrementCount()
    {
        count++;

        message = $"The state changed. Current value: {count}";
    }

    private void ResetCount()
    {
        count = 0;

        message = "The counter state has been reset.";
    }
}


The following examples demonstrate these ideas through complete Razor
components. The code is kept in separate blocks so each component can be
copied and reviewed independently.

Shared state between components
What if two unrelated components need the same data?

For example:
A navigation bar displays the logged-in user's name.
A profile component displays the same user's information.
Both need to reflect changes to that information.
You can create a shared state service.

@page "/admin/membership-plans"
@attribute [Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization.Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]

@using System.Net.Http.Json
@using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Forms

@inject HttpClient Http
@inject IJSRuntime JS

<PageTitle>Manage Membership Plans</PageTitle>

<div class="container-fluid py-4">
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center flex-wrap gap-3 mb-4">
        <div>
            <h2 class="fw-bold mb-1">Manage Membership Plans</h2>
            <p class="text-secondary mb-0">Create and maintain gym membership plans.</p>
        </div>
        <button class="btn btn-primary" @onclick="OpenAddForm">
            <i class="bi bi-plus-circle me-1"></i>Add Plan
        </button>
    </div>

    <div class="card shadow-sm border-0 mb-4">
        <div class="card-body">
            <div class="row g-3">
                <div class="col-12 col-lg-4">
                    <label class="form-label">Search</label>
                    <input class="form-control"
                           @bind="searchText"
                           @bind:event="oninput"
                           placeholder="Search plan or gym..." />
                </div>

                <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-lg-3">
                    <label class="form-label">Gym</label>
                    <select class="form-select" @bind="selectedGymId">
                        <option value="">All gyms</option>
                        @foreach (var gym in gyms)
                        {
                            <option value="@gym.Id">@gym.GymName</option>
                        }
                    </select>
                </div>

                <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-lg-3">
                    <label class="form-label">Sort by</label>
                    <select class="form-select" @bind="sortBy">
                        <option value="name">Plan name</option>
                        <option value="price">Price</option>
                        <option value="duration">Duration</option>
                        <option value="gym">Gym</option>
                        <option value="status">Status</option>
                    </select>
                </div>

                <div class="col-12 col-lg-2">
                    <label class="form-label">Page size</label>
                    <select class="form-select" @bind="pageSize" @bind:after="ResetPage">
                        <option value="5">5</option>
                        <option value="10">10</option>
                        <option value="20">20</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    @if (isLoading)
    {
        <div class="text-center py-5">
            <div class="spinner-border text-primary"></div>
            <p class="text-secondary mt-2">Loading membership plans...</p>
        </div>
    }
    else if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(errorMessage))
    {
        <div class="alert alert-danger">
            @errorMessage
            <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger ms-2"
                    @onclick="LoadDataAsync">Retry</button>
        </div>
    }
    else
    {
        <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm">
            <div class="table-responsive">
                <table class="table table-hover align-middle mb-0">
                    <thead class="table-light">
                        <tr>
                            <th>Plan</th>
                            <th>Gym</th>
                            <th>Price</th>
                            <th>Duration</th>
                            <th>Classes/week</th>
                            <th>Personal training</th>
                            <th>Locker</th>
                            <th>Guest access</th>
                            <th>Status</th>
                            <th class="text-end">Actions</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        @foreach (var plan in PagedPlans)
                        {
                            <tr @key="plan.Id">
                                <td class="fw-semibold">@plan.PlanName</td>
                                <td>@plan.GymName</td>
                                <td>@plan.Price.ToString("C")</td>
                                <td>@plan.DurationInMonths months</td>
                                <td>@plan.ClassSessionsPerWeek</td>
                                <td>@plan.PersonalTrainingSessions</td>
                                <td>@(plan.LockerAccess ? "Yes" : "No")</td>
                                <td>
                                    @(plan.GuestAccess
                                        ? $"Yes ({plan.GuestPasses} passes)"
                                        : "No")
                                </td>
                                <td>
                                    <span class="badge @(plan.Status == "Active"
                                        ? "bg-success" : "bg-secondary")">
                                        @plan.Status
                                    </span>
                                </td>
                                <td class="text-end text-nowrap">
                                    <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary me-1"
                                            @onclick="() => OpenEditForm(plan.Id)">
                                        <i class="bi bi-pencil"></i>
                                    </button>
                                    <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger"
                                            @onclick="() => DeletePlanAsync(plan.Id)">
                                        <i class="bi bi-trash"></i>
                                    </button>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        }
                        @if (PagedPlans.Count == 0)
                        {
                            <tr>
                                <td colspan="10" class="text-center py-4 text-secondary">
                                    No membership plans found.
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        }
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>

            <div class="card-body d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-between align-items-center gap-3">
                <span class="text-secondary">
                    Showing @ShowingFrom–@ShowingTo of @FilteredPlans.Count plans
                </span>
                <div class="d-flex gap-2 align-items-center">
                    <button class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm"
                            disabled="@(currentPage <= 1)"
                            @onclick="PreviousPage">Previous</button>
                    <span>Page @currentPage of @TotalPages</span>
                    <button class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm"
                            disabled="@(currentPage >= TotalPages)"
                            @onclick="NextPage">Next</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    }
</div>

@if (showForm)
{
    <div class="modal-backdrop-custom">
        <div class="card modal-card shadow-lg">
            <div class="card-header bg-white d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
                <h5 class="mb-0">@(isEditMode ? "Edit Plan" : "Add Plan")</h5>
                <button class="btn-close" @onclick="CloseForm"></button>
            </div>

            <div class="card-body">
                <EditForm Model="@formModel" OnValidSubmit="SavePlanAsync">
                    <DataAnnotationsValidator />
                    <ValidationSummary />

                    <div class="row g-3">
                        <div class="col-12">
                            <label class="form-label">Gym</label>
                            <InputSelect class="form-select" @bind-Value="formModel.GymId">
                                <option value="@Guid.Empty">Select gym</option>
                                @foreach (var gym in gyms.Where(g => g.Status == "Active"))
                                {
                                    <option value="@gym.Id">@gym.GymName</option>
                                }
                            </InputSelect>
                            <ValidationMessage For="@(() => formModel.GymId)" />
                        </div>

                        <div class="col-md-6">
                            <label class="form-label">Plan name</label>
                            <InputText class="form-control" @bind-Value="formModel.PlanName" />
                            <ValidationMessage For="@(() => formModel.PlanName)" />
                        </div>

                        <div class="col-md-6">
                            <label class="form-label">Price</label>
                            <InputNumber class="form-control" @bind-Value="formModel.Price" />
                            <ValidationMessage For="@(() => formModel.Price)" />
                        </div>

                        <div class="col-md-6">
                            <label class="form-label">Duration (months)</label>
                            <InputNumber class="form-control"
                                         @bind-Value="formModel.DurationInMonths" />
                            <ValidationMessage For="@(() => formModel.DurationInMonths)" />
                        </div>

                        <div class="col-md-6">
                            <label class="form-label">Class sessions per week</label>
                            <InputNumber class="form-control"
                                         @bind-Value="formModel.ClassSessionsPerWeek" />
                        </div>

                        <div class="col-md-6">
                            <label class="form-label">Personal training sessions</label>
                            <InputNumber class="form-control"
                                         @bind-Value="formModel.PersonalTrainingSessions" />
                        </div>

                        <div class="col-md-6">
                            <label class="form-label">Guest passes</label>
                            <InputNumber class="form-control" @bind-Value="formModel.GuestPasses" />
                        </div>

                        <div class="col-md-6">
                            <label class="form-label">Status</label>
                            <InputSelect class="form-select" @bind-Value="formModel.Status">
                                <option value="Active">Active</option>
                                <option value="Inactive">Inactive</option>
                            </InputSelect>
                        </div>

                        <div class="col-md-6 form-check ms-2">
                            <InputCheckbox class="form-check-input"
                                           @bind-Value="formModel.LockerAccess" />
                            <label class="form-check-label">Locker access</label>
                        </div>

                        <div class="col-md-6 form-check ms-2">
                            <InputCheckbox class="form-check-input"
                                           @bind-Value="formModel.GuestAccess" />
                            <label class="form-check-label">Guest access</label>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="d-flex justify-content-end gap-2 mt-4">
                        <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary"
                                @onclick="CloseForm" disabled="@isSaving">
                            Cancel
                        </button>
                        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" disabled="@isSaving">
                            @(isSaving ? "Saving..." : isEditMode ? "Update Plan" : "Save Plan")
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </EditForm>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
}

@code {
    public class GymOption
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public string GymName { get; set; } = "";
        public string Status { get; set; } = "";
    }

    public class PlanRow
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public Guid GymId { get; set; }
        public string GymName { get; set; } = "";
        public string PlanName { get; set; } = "";
        public decimal Price { get; set; }
        public int DurationInMonths { get; set; }
        public int ClassSessionsPerWeek { get; set; }
        public int PersonalTrainingSessions { get; set; }
        public bool LockerAccess { get; set; }
        public bool GuestAccess { get; set; }
        public int GuestPasses { get; set; }
        public string Status { get; set; } = "Active";
    }

    public class PlanForm
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }

        [Required]
        public Guid GymId { get; set; }

        [Required, StringLength(100)]
        public string PlanName { get; set; } = "";

        [Range(typeof(decimal), "0.01", "100000000")]
        public decimal Price { get; set; }

        [Range(1, 120)]
        public int DurationInMonths { get; set; } = 1;

        [Range(0, 100)]
        public int ClassSessionsPerWeek { get; set; }

        [Range(0, 100)]
        public int PersonalTrainingSessions { get; set; }

        public bool LockerAccess { get; set; }
        public bool GuestAccess { get; set; }

        [Range(0, 10000)]
        public int GuestPasses { get; set; }

        public string Status { get; set; } = "Active";
    }

    public class OperationResponse
    {
        public bool Success { get; set; }
        public string Message { get; set; } = "";
    }

    private List<GymOption> gyms = new();
    private List<PlanRow> plans = new();
    private PlanForm formModel = new();

    private bool isLoading;
    private bool isSaving;
    private bool showForm;
    private bool isEditMode;
    private string errorMessage = "";
    private string searchText = "";
    private string sortBy = "name";
    private string selectedGymId = "";
    private int currentPage = 1;
    private int pageSize = 10;

    private List<PlanRow> FilteredPlans
    {
        get
        {
            IEnumerable<PlanRow> query = plans;

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchText))
            {
                query = query.Where(p =>
                    p.PlanName.Contains(searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    p.GymName.Contains(searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            }

            if (Guid.TryParse(selectedGymId, out var gymId))
                query = query.Where(p => p.GymId == gymId);

            query = sortBy switch
            {
                "price" => query.OrderBy(p => p.Price),
                "duration" => query.OrderBy(p => p.DurationInMonths),
                "gym" => query.OrderBy(p => p.GymName),
                "status" => query.OrderBy(p => p.Status),
                _ => query.OrderBy(p => p.PlanName)
            };

            return query.ToList();
        }
    }

    private List<PlanRow> PagedPlans =>
        FilteredPlans.Skip((currentPage - 1) * pageSize).Take(pageSize).ToList();

    private int TotalPages => Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(FilteredPlans.Count / (double)pageSize));
    private int ShowingFrom => FilteredPlans.Count == 0 ? 0 : ((currentPage - 1) * pageSize) + 1;
    private int ShowingTo => Math.Min(currentPage * pageSize, FilteredPlans.Count);

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadDataAsync();

    private async Task LoadDataAsync()
    {
        isLoading = true;
        errorMessage = "";

        try
        {
            gyms = await Http.GetFromJsonAsync<List<GymOption>>("api/GymCenter") ?? new();
            plans = await Http.GetFromJsonAsync<List<PlanRow>>("api/MembershipPlan") ?? new();
            currentPage = Math.Min(currentPage, TotalPages);
        }
        catch
        {
            errorMessage = "Unable to load gyms or membership plans. Verify the API endpoints.";
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
        }
    }

    private void ResetPage() => currentPage = 1;
    private void PreviousPage() { if (currentPage > 1) currentPage--; }
    private void NextPage() { if (currentPage < TotalPages) currentPage++; }

    private void OpenAddForm()
    {
        formModel = new PlanForm();
        isEditMode = false;
        showForm = true;
    }

    private void OpenEditForm(Guid id)
    {
        var plan = plans.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == id);
        if (plan is null) return;

        formModel = new PlanForm
        {
            Id = plan.Id,
            GymId = plan.GymId,
            PlanName = plan.PlanName,
            Price = plan.Price,
            DurationInMonths = plan.DurationInMonths,
            ClassSessionsPerWeek = plan.ClassSessionsPerWeek,
            PersonalTrainingSessions = plan.PersonalTrainingSessions,
            LockerAccess = plan.LockerAccess,
            GuestAccess = plan.GuestAccess,
            GuestPasses = plan.GuestPasses,
            Status = plan.Status
        };

        isEditMode = true;
        showForm = true;
    }

    private async Task SavePlanAsync()
    {
        if (formModel.GymId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            await ShowMessageAsync("Select a gym", "Please select a gym for this plan.", false);
            return;
        }

        if (formModel.GuestAccess == false)
            formModel.GuestPasses = 0;

        isSaving = true;

        try
        {
            HttpResponseMessage response = isEditMode
                ? await Http.PutAsJsonAsync($"api/MembershipPlan/{formModel.Id}", formModel)
                : await Http.PostAsJsonAsync("api/MembershipPlan", formModel);

            var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<OperationResponse>();

            if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode || result?.Success != true)
            {
                await ShowMessageAsync("Unable to save plan",
                    result?.Message ?? "The plan could not be saved.", false);
                return;
            }

            showForm = false;
            await LoadDataAsync();
            await ShowMessageAsync("Success", result.Message, true);
        }
        catch
        {
            await ShowMessageAsync("Error", "An error occurred while saving the plan.", false);
        }
        finally
        {
            isSaving = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task DeletePlanAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var confirmed = await JS.InvokeAsync<bool>(
            "gymUi.confirmDelete", "Delete membership plan?",
            "The API will check whether active subscriptions prevent deletion.");

        if (!confirmed) return;

        try
        {
            var response = await Http.DeleteAsync($"api/MembershipPlan/{id}");
            var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<OperationResponse>();

            if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode || result?.Success != true)
            {
                await ShowMessageAsync("Unable to delete",
                    result?.Message ?? "The plan could not be deleted.", false);
                return;
            }

            await LoadDataAsync();
            await ShowMessageAsync("Success", result.Message, true);
        }
        catch
        {
            await ShowMessageAsync("Error", "An error occurred while deleting the plan.", false);
        }
    }

    private void CloseForm()
    {
        if (!isSaving) showForm = false;
    }

    private Task ShowMessageAsync(string title, string message, bool success) =>
        JS.InvokeVoidAsync("gymUi.showMessage", title, message, success).AsTask();
}

@using System.Net.Http.Json
@using System.Globalization

@inject HttpClient Http

<PageTitle>Manage Memberships</PageTitle>

<div class="container-fluid py-4">
    <div class="mb-4">
        <h2 class="fw-bold mb-1">Manage Memberships</h2>
        <p class="text-secondary mb-0">
            Review subscriptions, registration dates, and membership status.
        </p>
    </div>

    <div class="card shadow-sm border-0 mb-4">
        <div class="card-body">
            <div class="row g-3">
                <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-4">
                    <label class="form-label">Search</label>
                    <input class="form-control"
                           @bind="searchText"
                           @bind:event="oninput"
                           placeholder="Member, gym, or plan..." />
                </div>

                <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-2">
                    <label class="form-label">Gym</label>
                    <select class="form-select" @bind="selectedGymId">
                        <option value="">All gyms</option>
                        @foreach (var gym in GymOptions)
                        {
                            <option value="@gym.Id">@gym.GymName</option>
                        }
                    </select>
                </div>

                <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-2">
                    <label class="form-label">Member</label>
                    <select class="form-select" @bind="selectedUserId">
                        <option value="">All members</option>
                        @foreach (var member in MemberOptions)
                        {
                            <option value="@member.Id">@member.MemberName</option>
                        }
                    </select>
                </div>

                <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-2">
                    <label class="form-label">Plan</label>
                    <select class="form-select" @bind="selectedPlanId">
                        <option value="">All plans</option>
                        @foreach (var plan in PlanOptions)
                        {
                            <option value="@plan.Id">@plan.PlanName</option>
                        }
                    </select>
                </div>

                <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-2">
                    <label class="form-label">Status</label>
                    <select class="form-select" @bind="selectedStatus">
                        <option value="">All statuses</option>
                        <option value="Pending">Pending</option>
                        <option value="Active">Active</option>
                        <option value="Expiring Soon">Expiring Soon</option>
                        <option value="Expired">Expired</option>
                        <option value="Cancelled">Cancelled</option>
                    </select>
                </div>

                <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-3">
                    <label class="form-label">Registered from</label>
                    <input type="date" class="form-control" @bind="registrationFrom" />
                </div>

                <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-3">
                    <label class="form-label">Registered to</label>
                    <input type="date" class="form-control" @bind="registrationTo" />
                </div>

                <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-3">
                    <label class="form-label">Sort by</label>
                    <select class="form-select" @bind="sortBy">
                        <option value="registration">Registration date</option>
                        <option value="member">Member</option>
                        <option value="gym">Gym</option>
                        <option value="plan">Plan</option>
                        <option value="start">Start date</option>
                        <option value="end">End date</option>
                        <option value="status">Status</option>
                    </select>
                </div>

                <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-3">
                    <label class="form-label">Page size</label>
                    <select class="form-select" @bind="pageSize" @bind:after="ResetPage">
                        <option value="5">5</option>
                        <option value="10">10</option>
                        <option value="20">20</option>
                    </select>
                </div>

                <div class="col-12 d-flex gap-2">
                    <button class="btn btn-outline-secondary" @onclick="ClearFilters">
                        Clear filters
                    </button>
                    <button class="btn btn-outline-primary" @onclick="LoadMembershipsAsync">
                        <i class="bi bi-arrow-clockwise me-1"></i>Refresh
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    @if (isLoading)
    {
        <div class="text-center py-5">
            <div class="spinner-border text-primary"></div>
            <p class="text-secondary mt-2">Loading memberships...</p>
        </div>
    }
    else if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(errorMessage))
    {
        <div class="alert alert-danger">
            @errorMessage
            <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger ms-2"
                    @onclick="LoadMembershipsAsync">Retry</button>
        </div>
    }
    else
    {
        <div class="card shadow-sm border-0">
            <div class="table-responsive">
                <table class="table table-hover align-middle mb-0">
                    <thead class="table-light">
                        <tr>
                            <th>Member</th>
                            <th>Gym</th>
                            <th>Plan</th>
                            <th>Registered</th>
                            <th>Start date</th>
                            <th>End date</th>
                            <th>Status</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        @foreach (var membership in PagedMemberships)
                        {
                            var status = GetMembershipStatus(membership);

                            <tr @key="membership.Id">
                                <td>
                                    <div class="fw-semibold">@membership.MemberName</div>
                                    <div class="small text-secondary">@membership.MemberEmail</div>
                                </td>
                                <td>@membership.GymName</td>
                                <td>@membership.PlanName</td>
                                <td>@membership.RegistrationDate.ToString("dd MMM yyyy")</td>
                                <td>@membership.StartDate.ToString("dd MMM yyyy")</td>
                                <td>@membership.EndDate.ToString("dd MMM yyyy")</td>
                                <td>
                                    <span class="badge @GetStatusBadgeClass(status)">
                                        @status
                                    </span>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        }

                        @if (PagedMemberships.Count == 0)
                        {
                            <tr>
                                <td colspan="7" class="text-center py-4 text-secondary">
                                    No memberships match the selected filters.
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        }
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>

            <div class="card-body d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-between align-items-center gap-3">
                <span class="text-secondary">
                    Showing @ShowingFrom–@ShowingTo of @FilteredMemberships.Count memberships
                </span>

                <div class="d-flex gap-2 align-items-center">
                    <button class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm"
                            disabled="@(currentPage <= 1)"
                            @onclick="PreviousPage">Previous</button>
                    <span>Page @currentPage of @TotalPages</span>
                    <button class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm"
                            disabled="@(currentPage >= TotalPages)"
                            @onclick="NextPage">Next</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    }
</div>

@code {
    public class MembershipRowModel
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public Guid GymId { get; set; }
        public Guid MembershipPlanId { get; set; }
        public Guid UserId { get; set; }

        public string GymName { get; set; } = "";
        public string MemberName { get; set; } = "";
        public string MemberEmail { get; set; } = "";
        public string PlanName { get; set; } = "";

        public DateTime RegistrationDate { get; set; }
        public DateTime StartDate { get; set; }
        public DateTime EndDate { get; set; }

        // Expected values: Pending, Active, Cancelled, Expired.
        // Expiring Soon is derived from an active membership near its end date.
        public string Status { get; set; } = "";
    }

    public class GymOption
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public string GymName { get; set; } = "";
    }

    public class MemberOption
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public string MemberName { get; set; } = "";
    }

    public class PlanOption
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public string PlanName { get; set; } = "";
    }

    private List<MembershipRowModel> memberships = new();
    private bool isLoading;
    private string errorMessage = "";
    private string searchText = "";
    private string selectedGymId = "";
    private string selectedUserId = "";
    private string selectedPlanId = "";
    private string selectedStatus = "";
    private string sortBy = "registration";
    private DateTime? registrationFrom;
    private DateTime? registrationTo;
    private int currentPage = 1;
    private int pageSize = 10;

    private List<GymOption> GymOptions =>
        memberships.GroupBy(m => m.GymId)
            .Select(g => new GymOption
            {
                Id = g.Key,
                GymName = g.First().GymName
            })
            .OrderBy(g => g.GymName)
            .ToList();

    private List<MemberOption> MemberOptions =>
        memberships.GroupBy(m => m.UserId)
            .Select(g => new MemberOption
            {
                Id = g.Key,
                MemberName = g.First().MemberName
            })
            .OrderBy(m => m.MemberName)
            .ToList();

    private List<PlanOption> PlanOptions =>
        memberships.GroupBy(m => m.MembershipPlanId)
            .Select(g => new PlanOption
            {
                Id = g.Key,
                PlanName = g.First().PlanName
            })
            .OrderBy(p => p.PlanName)
            .ToList();

    private List<MembershipRowModel> FilteredMemberships
    {
        get
        {
            IEnumerable<MembershipRowModel> query = memberships;

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchText))
            {
                query = query.Where(m =>
                    m.MemberName.Contains(searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    m.MemberEmail.Contains(searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    m.GymName.Contains(searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    m.PlanName.Contains(searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            }

            if (Guid.TryParse(selectedGymId, out var gymId))
                query = query.Where(m => m.GymId == gymId);

            if (Guid.TryParse(selectedUserId, out var userId))
                query = query.Where(m => m.UserId == userId);

            if (Guid.TryParse(selectedPlanId, out var planId))
                query = query.Where(m => m.MembershipPlanId == planId);

            if (registrationFrom.HasValue)
                query = query.Where(m => m.RegistrationDate.Date >= registrationFrom.Value.Date);

            if (registrationTo.HasValue)
                query = query.Where(m => m.RegistrationDate.Date <= registrationTo.Value.Date);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(selectedStatus))
                query = query.Where(m => GetMembershipStatus(m) == selectedStatus);

            query = sortBy switch
            {
                "member" => query.OrderBy(m => m.MemberName),
                "gym" => query.OrderBy(m => m.GymName),
                "plan" => query.OrderBy(m => m.PlanName),
                "start" => query.OrderBy(m => m.StartDate),
                "end" => query.OrderBy(m => m.EndDate),
                "status" => query.OrderBy(m => GetMembershipStatus(m)),
                _ => query.OrderByDescending(m => m.RegistrationDate)
            };

            return query.ToList();
        }
    }

    private List<MembershipRowModel> PagedMemberships =>
        FilteredMemberships.Skip((currentPage - 1) * pageSize).Take(pageSize).ToList();

    private int TotalPages =>
        Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(FilteredMemberships.Count / (double)pageSize));

    private int ShowingFrom =>
        FilteredMemberships.Count == 0 ? 0 : ((currentPage - 1) * pageSize) + 1;

    private int ShowingTo =>
        Math.Min(currentPage * pageSize, FilteredMemberships.Count);

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadMembershipsAsync();

    private async Task LoadMembershipsAsync()
    {
        isLoading = true;
        errorMessage = "";

        try
        {
            memberships =
                await Http.GetFromJsonAsync<List<MembershipRowModel>>(
                    "api/Subscription/AdminList") ?? new();

            currentPage = Math.Min(currentPage, TotalPages);
        }
        catch
        {
            errorMessage =
                "Unable to load memberships. Check that api/Subscription/AdminList exists and returns the expected data.";
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
        }
    }

    private static string GetMembershipStatus(MembershipRowModel membership)
    {
        // Cancellation always takes precedence over date-based statuses.
        if (string.Equals(membership.Status, "Cancelled",
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "Cancelled";

        if (string.Equals(membership.Status, "Pending",
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            membership.StartDate.Date > DateTime.Today)
            return "Pending";

        if (membership.EndDate.Date < DateTime.Today ||
            string.Equals(membership.Status, "Expired",
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "Expired";

        var daysRemaining = (membership.EndDate.Date - DateTime.Today).Days;

        if (daysRemaining <= 7)
            return "Expiring Soon";

        return "Active";
    }

    private static string GetStatusBadgeClass(string status) => status switch
    {
        "Pending" => "bg-warning text-dark",
        "Active" => "bg-success",
        "Expiring Soon" => "bg-info text-dark",
        "Expired" => "bg-secondary",
        "Cancelled" => "bg-danger",
        _ => "bg-secondary"
    };

    private void ResetPage() => currentPage = 1;
    private void PreviousPage() { if (currentPage > 1) currentPage--; }
    private void NextPage() { if (currentPage < TotalPages) currentPage++; }

    private void ClearFilters()
    {
        searchText = "";
        selectedGymId = "";
        selectedUserId = "";
        selectedPlanId = "";
        selectedStatus = "";
        registrationFrom = null;
        registrationTo = null;
        sortBy = "registration";
        currentPage = 1;
    }
}

title: Predicting Live Birth After Fresh Embryo Transfer in IVF/ICSI: Differential ICM/Trophectoderm Morphology Encoding and a Hybrid Attention--Logistic Regression Ensemble
description:
arXiv:2610.21134v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Predicting live birth before fresh embryo transfer could support shared decision-making in IVF/ICSI, but routine clinical data are small, heterogeneous, and contain pathway-dependent variables prone to outcome leakage. We aimed to construct a curated single-centre IVF/ICSI dataset and develop a prediction model suited to small tabular clinical data. \textit{Materials and Methods:} We assembled 616 fresh embryo-transfer cycles (251 live birth, 365 non-live birth) with clinical, laboratory, and embryological predictors, and embryo morphology encoded with a novel differential weighting of the inner cell mass and trophectoderm. After KNN imputation, robust scaling, and selection of 50 features, we developed a Hybrid Attention Network (HAN), a learnable feature-attention gate followed by a compact multilayer perceptron, and a HAN + logistic-regression (LR) ensemble with a validation-tuned weight. Models were benchmarked against classical machine learning, TabPFN, and text-serialized language models on a held-out test set; AUC-ROC was the primary metric. \textit{Results:} The HAN + LR ensemble achieved the highest test AUC-ROC (0.710; accuracy 0.710, F1 0.630), ahead of the HAN backbone alone (0.700), logistic regression (0.667), the TabPFN + LR hybrid (0.666), and TabPFN (0.650). Text-serialized language models performed near chance (AUC $\le$ 0.61). The differentially weighted trophectoderm feature ranked highest by consensus importance across models. \textit{Discussion:} A compact attention network combined with a linear model outperformed both components and strong foundation-model baselines on a small clinical cohort. \textit{Conclusion:} The curated dataset and HAN + LR ensemble offer a transparent, reproducible basis for IVF/ICSI live-birth prediction; external validation is the next step.

title: FlowBudget: Training-Free Sampling-Budget Estimation for Flow Matching Models
description:
arXiv:2610.20636v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Sampling from continuous flow-based generators such as flow matching models requires numerical ODE or SDE integration, making inference cost depend on the number of function evaluations (NFEs). In practice, the sampling budget is inherited from prior work or selected through expensive FID-versus-NFE sweeps, using FID to assess image-generation quality, requiring sample generation and evaluation at multiple budgets. This makes sampling-budget selection dependent on repeated empirical evaluation. We therefore ask a complementary question to solver design and timestep allocation: for a fixed pretrained model and solver, what numerical resolution is sufficient? We introduce FLOWBUDGET, a training-free estimator of solver-relative sampling complexity. Using simulation-free interpolation probes of the learned dynamics, FLOWBUDGET normalizes the leading one-step discretization error by the motion, estimates its coefficient from interpolation probes, and maps a numerical tolerance to a step budget using the solver order. We derive estimators for numerical solvers in flow~matching sampling, namely Euler and Heun for ODE sampling and additive-noise Euler--Maruyama for SDE sampling, and connect the ODE coefficients to terminal integration error. Experiments on SiT, FlowDCN and Rectified Flow models, spanning flow-model architectures and formulations, test whether FLOWBUDGET can estimate the NFE budget without generating samples at multiple budgets or performing an FID-versus-NFE sweep. The code is available at https://github.com/Yasaman-dt/FlowBudget

title: I hate letting AI write my Rust. So I built a coach that won't.
description:
You've probably learned some Rust this way: you hit a borrow checker error, paste it into a chatbot, get a clear explanation and a fixed version, paste that back, and the build goes green. It feels productive. A week later you hit the same error and you're back in the chat window.

The explanation was fine. What was missing is everything around it: an order to learn things in, someone who remembers what you got wrong last time, and a rule that says you write the code until it actually passes.

That's what I built rustcoach for. It's an AI coach (built on Claude) wrapped in a structure that a chat window doesn't have. This post walks through it with screenshots from a real lesson.

Start by finding out what you actually know

Before any lesson, you can take a free Rust skills test. You don't need an account.

  • General test: 30 questions across all five areas, about ten minutes.
  • Module test: 20 questions on one area: async, macros, concurrency or the type system.

Questions go from easiest to hardest, and most of them show real Rust code: what does this print, does this compile, which line panics. You see the right answer and the reasoning right after each one, so the test teaches while it measures.

The bank has 609 questions, and 446 of them include a Rust snippet. Each snippet carries a claim (it compiles, it fails with a specific error, it prints this output, or it panics), and a tool compiles and runs every snippet to check that claim. A question that says "this prints X" has actually been run and printed X.

At the end you get a level (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced or Expert), a bar per area, your strongest and weakest topics, every question you missed with the correct answer, and a recommendation for which module to take. Here's mine after clicking through at random to get to the report quickly. It doesn't flatter you:

If you sign up afterwards, you can choose to share the result with the coach. That's off by default. If you turn it on, the coach plans your first lessons knowing which topics you got right and wrong.

Structure: a syllabus, in order

A chatbot waits for you to know what to ask. rustcoach gives you five courses, each with its own chapters, topics and progress:

Module Chapters Topics
Core Rust 16 50
Async & Tokio 12 51
Macros 11 50
Concurrency & Atomics 12 52
Advanced Types & Traits 11 50

Core Rust goes from bindings, ownership and borrowing through traits, lifetimes, iterators, smart pointers, threads, macros, unsafe and async. Each deep-dive module opens with a short Foundations chapter, and any topics you already covered in Core Rust start ticked off.

Every topic has a mastery score and the coach's own notes on how you did. It goes up when you get things right and down when you don't:

A lesson is written for you

There's no "lesson 7" that everyone gets. The coach reads its notes on you first, re-tests what went wrong last time, then teaches one idea with code you can run.

Every two or three explanations, it stops and checks that the idea landed: one question, a few options, one click.

The rail on the right keeps the context in view: the topic's mastery and the coach's note on you, review cards due, and this lesson's quick-check score.

Then you write the code. Until it's correct.

This is the part that makes the difference. Each lesson builds to an assignment: a real cargo crate with integration tests, written to fail on the starter code and pass on a correct solution. You code in the browser and the tests run with real cargo test in a locked-down sandbox (no network, capped memory and CPU, read-only filesystem).

In this lesson the assignment was a vending machine: restock must treat a zero count as a bug (assert!), and buy must treat "not enough money" as an expected failure (Err). Here are the starter's tests going red:

My first attempt didn't compile. Each rustc error is listed and its line tinted:

Explain with the coach turns the error into plain English: what is wrong, and what to try. It doesn't write the fix for you:

Stuck on what to reach for? Hints puts a coach note next to each function: the API to use and the trap to avoid, never the answer.

When it builds, every run also runs cargo clippy. Each lint shows up as a broom in the gutter, with the message, the help and a link. My solution passed all five tests and still got one:

Trace runs a function through one of its tests and shows the value of every variable, line by line. It's a debugger for people who don't have one set up yet:

The review: green tests aren't the end

When you submit, the coach reviews the code like a pull request: correctness first, then idioms, style and understanding. Clippy notes go to the coach too, and it teaches the idiom behind one of them.

Look at the second paragraph: "This is the second lesson in a row with this lint." It remembered. It also pointed out something I got right without being asked: each u32 subtraction sits on the branch where it can't underflow.

Accepted work can earn one optional stretch challenge, like making this version more idiomatic. So I tried the obvious thing:

It said no, explained why, and split the task into steps with examples on different data that you can't paste in. This is the core rule: the coach never writes your assignment's solution, not even when you ask or say you give up. You can ask as many questions as you want and get as many hints, explanations and examples as you need, but the code you submit is always yours.

Remembering, so it sticks

Writing the code once isn't enough. When a lesson is signed off, the coach writes two review cards per topic it covered. They come back after 1, 3, 7, 14, 30 and 60 days, and a wrong answer sends the card back to the start, so it returns tomorrow.

Every lesson stays in History, with the coach's summary of what it taught, how you did and what to revisit, plus the full transcript:

Any topic you've been taught can be redone. The redo pauses the running lesson and keeps your editor code, then returns you to it afterwards.

Small things developers will like

If you're coming from Python, JavaScript or Java, these are the details that make it feel like a dev tool rather than a course:

  • The real toolchain. Your code goes through cargo test, cargo clippy and rustfmt. The errors and lints you see are the compiler's own, not simulated.
  • Keyboard first. ⌘↵ runs tests, ⌘⇧F formats, ⌘⇧↵ submits, and ? lists every shortcut.
  • scratch.rs. A throwaway binary crate next to the assignment for "wait, what does this actually do?" moments.
  • Explain a selection. Select any code (or put the cursor in a function), hit Explain, and it goes to the coach as a question.
  • Your weak spots, tracked. Every topic keeps a mastery score and the coach's notes, and the coach re-tests what you got wrong before teaching something new.
  • Streaks and milestones. They're small, and they work.

What it costs

There's no subscription. A new account starts with 5 free credits, which last up to 5 lessons, and you don't need a card. After that, the Course is $49 once (before tax) for 50 credits. That covers a typical learner through one full module if you already program a bit in another language. Top-ups start at $10. The skills test is free and needs no account.

Try it

Test your Rust (free, no account): rustcoach.dev/test
Start learning: rustcoach.dev

title: CSS Flexbox Advanced: flex-grow vs flex-basis, Auto Margins, and the Firefox Flex Inspector
description:
CSS Flexbox handles one-dimensional layouts — rows or columns. Most developers know the basics, but the advanced flex properties enable precise alignment, sizing, and ordering that solves complex real-world layout problems. Firefox has excellent Flex inspection in DevTools.

The Flex Model

Flex containers establish a flex formatting context. Children become flex items.

.container {
  display: flex; /* or inline-flex */
  flex-direction: row; /* row (default), row-reverse, column, column-reverse */
  flex-wrap: nowrap; /* nowrap (default), wrap, wrap-reverse */
  /* Shorthand: */
  flex-flow: row wrap;
}

Alignment

Two axes: main axis (flex-direction) and cross axis (perpendicular).

.container {
  /* Main axis alignment */
  justify-content: flex-start; /* default */
  justify-content: flex-end;
  justify-content: center;
  justify-content: space-between; /* gaps between items */
  justify-content: space-around;  /* gaps around items */
  justify-content: space-evenly;  /* equal gaps everywhere */

  /* Cross axis alignment */
  align-items: stretch; /* default: items stretch to fill cross size */
  align-items: flex-start;
  align-items: flex-end;
  align-items: center;
  align-items: baseline; /* align text baselines */

  /* Multi-line cross axis alignment (when flex-wrap: wrap) */
  align-content: flex-start;
  align-content: space-between;
  align-content: stretch;

  /* Shorthand for both axes */
  place-items: center;        /* align-items justify-items */
  place-content: space-between center; /* align-content justify-content */
}

Flex Item Properties 

.item {
  /* Growth factor: how much extra space item gets */
  flex-grow: 0; /* default: don't grow */
  flex-grow: 1; /* gets 1 share of extra space */
  flex-grow: 2; /* gets 2 shares (twice as much as flex-grow: 1) */

  /* Shrink factor: how much item shrinks when container is too small */
  flex-shrink: 1; /* default: shrink equally */
  flex-shrink: 0; /* never shrink */

  /* Base size before distribution */
  flex-basis: auto; /* use item's natural size */
  flex-basis: 200px; /* start at 200px, then grow/shrink */
  flex-basis: 0; /* ignore content size, distribute purely by flex-grow */

  /* Shorthand: flex-grow flex-shrink flex-basis */
  flex: 0 0 200px; /* Fixed 200px, no grow/shrink */
  flex: 1;         /* Same as flex: 1 1 0 — equal distribution */
  flex: auto;      /* flex: 1 1 auto — grow/shrink proportionally from natural size */
  flex: none;      /* flex: 0 0 auto — don't flex at all */
}

The flex: 1 Shorthand 

/* These are equivalent: */
.item { flex: 1; }
.item { flex-grow: 1; flex-shrink: 1; flex-basis: 0; }

/* vs. */
.item { flex: 1 1 auto; }
/* flex-basis: auto means "start from content size" */
/* flex-basis: 0 means "ignore content, distribute proportionally" */

The difference matters for unequal content sizes:

  • flex: 1 (basis 0): all items get equal space regardless of content
  • flex: auto: items start at their natural size, then extra space is distributed

Per-Item Alignment Override 

.container { align-items: center; }

.item-special {
  align-self: flex-start; /* Overrides container's align-items */
}

.item-fill {
  align-self: stretch;
}

Order

Change visual order without changing DOM order (affects tab order too, so use carefully):

.container { display: flex; }

.first { order: 1; }
.second { order: 2; }
.third { order: -1; } /* Negative values come first */

Tab order follows DOM order, not visual order — using order while adding interactive content can confuse keyboard users.

Practical Patterns

Sticky Footer 

body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

main {
  flex: 1; /* Grows to fill space, pushing footer down */
}

footer {
  /* Natural size — no flex needed */
}

Centering (Classic Flexbox Use Case) 

.center-content {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

/* Alternative with auto margins */
.container { display: flex; }
.centered-item { margin: auto; } /* Auto margins in flex: absorb all available space */

Navigation Bar 

.navbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 24px;
  gap: 16px;
}

.navbar .logo { margin-right: auto; } /* Pushes everything else to the right */
.navbar .menu { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.navbar .actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; }

Card Grid with Equal Heights 

.card-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
}

.card {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.card-content { flex: 1; } /* Pushes footer to bottom of each card */
.card-footer { /* Natural height */ }

Firefox DevTools: Flex Inspector

Firefox's Layout panel has excellent Flex visualization:

  1. Open DevTools → Layout tab
  2. Under "Flex" section, click the flex icon on any flex container
  3. The overlay shows:
    • Item boundaries
    • Flex lines
    • Available free space
    • Item grow/shrink behavior

The overlay is interactive — hover over items to see their computed flex-grow, flex-shrink, flex-basis, and final size.

Auto Margins in Flex

Flexbox auto margins absorb free space:

.nav { display: flex; align-items: center; }
.nav .logo { /* natural size */ }
.nav .spacer { flex: 1; } /* Takes all free space */
.nav .login { /* natural size */ }

/* Alternative: auto margin on logo pushes everything else right */
.nav .logo { margin-right: auto; }

Both patterns achieve the same result: logo on left, login on right.

title: Feature Elicitation for SAE Steering of Deceptive Behaviour in Small LLMs
description:
arXiv:2610.20638v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Research on deceptive alignment is becoming increasingly urgent as frontier-model capabilities advance and their risk of causing catastrophic harm increases. Alignment faking is a form of deceptive alignment, with the compliance gap serving as a key behavioural indicator. This behaviour remains understudied in small LLMs and prior mechanistic interventions have not been shown to mitigate the compliance gap. We test whether steering SAE (sparse autoencoders) features associated with deontological ethics can mitigate this behaviour. We use a novel bag-of-words feature elicitation pipeline for SAE steering to identify what we construe as concept-level steering directions. Our approach reduced the compliance gap to non-significance in Gemma-3-27B-IT, whereas the tested configurations were not effective in LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct. Analysis of scratchpad traces also revealed deceptive model behaviour which we term deceptive defanging: deliberately degrading the aligned functionality of a response (in this case harmfulness) while preserving the appearance of alignment (in this case helpful compliance with the harmful request), sometimes conditioned on tier, training, or RLHF consequences. These findings provide, to our knowledge, the first evidence that a mechanistic activation-level intervention can mitigate the compliance gap in an alignment faking setup. They also identify a form of deceptive behaviour that may broaden our understanding of the different forms of deceptive behaviour in LLMs.
